glosses: past passive perfective participle of поджа́рить (podžáritʹ)

examples.text: Пе́ред пода́чей на стол капу́сту обсы́пать поджа́ренными сухаря́ми, встряхну́ть и положи́ть на блю́до.

glosses: кулин. приготовленный для еды тепловой обработкой с добавлением жира на открытом огне, сковороде, гриле и т. п.

examples.text: Я вдыхал запах хлеба, густой аромат буханок, где запах горящего масла смешивался с запахом поджаренной муки.

glosses: simple past and past participle of fry

examples.text: He always ate his eggs fried, never scrambled.

glosses: Cooked in a deep fryer or pressure fryer or the like after being coated (breaded) in batter; compare deep-fried.

examples.text: Innawong et al. (2006) conducted experiments to study the effect of using nitrogen gas on the quality of fried chicken nuggets during pressure frying in terms of moisture retention and reduction in fat […]

The level of seasoning is lower when the chicken is to be open kettle fried; this is because the open kettle-fried chicken has a thicker coating of breading than chicken to be pressure fried. […] Gently shake the fry baskets several times to prevent the sticking of chicken pieces to each other, which can cause raw breading spots on the fried chicken.

glosses: Broken as a result of excessive heat or an electrical surge.

examples.text: It looks like your motherboard is fried.
Optics - totally fried. And let's not even talk about the power supply. You know how expensive this gear is, son?.

glosses: Stoned; under the influence of drugs.

examples.text: Man, I got totally fried on weed at Chad's party.

glosses: Drunk; under the influence of alcohol.

examples.text: The police had to send a squad car / When Daddy got fried on vodka

glosses: Extremely tired due to exertion or stress; exhausted.

examples.text: After nearly twelve hours at the office plus a nightmare commute home, I was fried and couldn’t think of anything but sleep.
The pleasant aroma arising from roasted coffee beans during grinding is as attractive as the aroma of fresh brewed coffee for coffee flavored prepared foods.

glosses: simple past and past participle of roast
simple past and past participle of grill

examples.text: The meat was grilled as this was considered the healthier option.
She grilled him over his whereabouts the previous night.

glosses: As if cooked on a grill.

examples.text: After a day in the sun, he looked more grilled than his hamburger.
High up, at second-storey level, are small openings cut into the wall and filled with shuttered, grilled windows […]

glosses: durch Erhitzen, ohne umgebende Flüssigkeit oder in Fett, gegart

examples.text: „Jetzt stirbt sie wirklich. In einer Hand noch immer das Ausbeinmesser. In der anderen Hand noch immer den Fleischfetzen ihres gebratenen Arsches.“
